* feat(llmobs): add @typesafe-ai/sdk integration

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(llmobs): record typesafe image assets by reference and capture requests at call time

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(llmobs): log typesafe result read failures and report total tokens only when both counts are present

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(typesafe): list @typesafe-ai/sdk in supported versions and fail loudly if systemOne moves

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(llmobs): cover typesafe withResponse, map, default model, OpenRouter provider, and recorded errors

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(typesafe): skip specs on Node.js versions the SDK does not support

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(typesafe): fix import order of the Node.js version gate

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(typesafe): run the typesafe job on active LTS instead of Node.js 18

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(typesafe): gate each SDK version on its own engines range

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(llmobs): record typesafe named assets under the names the SDK sends

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(llmobs): record TypeSafe request and response bodies as sent

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(typesafe): cover response body read failures

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(typesafe): read results from the caller's own calls

Record the request body the SDK serialized instead of serializing it again,
and finish the span on the caller's path to the result instead of reading a
clone of the response.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(typesafe): instrument with Orchestrion

Trace systemOne and observe the response promise each APIPromise is
constructed with, so every way of consuming the result, including calls
that are never awaited, finishes the span. The request is recorded as
passed instead of from the SDK's internal fetchWithRetries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(typesafe): drop debug logs on response read failures

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(typesafe): only chain the response promise of systemOne

Observe the APIPromise built while systemOne runs instead of chaining every
APIPromise and filtering when the response arrives, so other SDK calls and
map() get no extra promise.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(typesafe): only report total tokens when both counts are known

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(typesafe): tag System One spans with decision_provider

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(typesafe): use typesafe as the decision_provider

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(typesafe): cover concurrent systemOne requests

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(typesafe): record errors reading the response on the span

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(typesafe): look up the systemOne context by APIPromise again

Map each APIPromise systemOne returns to its context instead of handing the
context through a module-level variable.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(typesafe): add the instrumentation manifest

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(typesafe): remove the instrumentation manifest

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
